questions.question: Which role is required to create HR cases in ServiceNow?

explanation.correct: The sn_hr_core.case_writer role grants access to write all HR cases. Users with this role can access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and view, create, and work on existing cases. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/setup-configurable-hr-agent-workspace.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.basic grants basic HR agent access to modules but not case creation permissions.
sn_hr_core.manager grants access to all HR cases, profiles, and secure information, but case_writer is specifically for creating cases.
sn_hr_agent_ws.admin is for configuring Agent Workspace, not creating HR cases.

source.excerpt: HR case writer [sn_hr_core.case_writer] - Grants access to write all HR cases. With this role, you can access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and view, create, and work on existing cases.

questions.question: What is the navigation path to create a new HR case in ServiceNow?

options.text: All > HR Service Delivery > Create Case
All > HR Case Management > Create New Case

explanation.correct: To create a new HR case, navigate to All > HR Case Management > Create New Case. Alternatively, from any case list, you can click New. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: HR Service Delivery is a product name, not a module path for case creation.
HR Administration is used for administrative configurations like Playbook Card Configuration, not case creation.
Employee Center is for employee self-service, not agent case creation.

source.excerpt: Navigate to All > HR Case Management > Create New Case. Or, from any case list, click New.

questions.question: Which fields are available when creating an HR case in the Case Details section? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: The Case Details section includes COE (Center of Excellence) and HR service fields. The COE filters available HR services, and selecting an HR service can auto-populate the associated COE. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: HR Profile ID is part of the Employee Information section, not Case Details.
Cost Center is not a standard field in the HR case creation Case Details section.
Manager Approval is not part of Case Details; approvals are handled separately in workflows.

source.excerpt: COE - The Center of Excellence associated with the HR case you are creating. Selecting a COE filters the choices for HR service. HR service - The HR service based on the COE selected or what you select based on communication with the employee request.

questions.question: What happens when you select the 'Skip verification' option during HR case creation?

options.text: The case is created without manager approval
The case is created without entering an employee name and the Employee Information section is not displayed
The case bypasses all validation rules
The case is assigned directly to an HR agent without routing

explanation.correct: Selecting Skip verification creates the case without having to enter an employee name or case number. This option takes you directly to the Case Details section and the Employee Information section is not displayed. This is useful for anonymous employees or external individuals. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Skip verification relates to employee identification, not approval workflows.
Skip verification only skips employee verification, not all validation rules.
Case routing is handled separately by assignment rules, not the skip verification option.

source.excerpt: Select Skip verification to create the case without having to enter an employee name or case number. Selecting this option takes you directly to the Case Details section and the Employee Information section is not displayed.

questions.question: Which plugin must be activated for the Document Template Type field to appear when configuring an HR service?

explanation.correct: The Document Template Type field appears only when the Document Templates [com.snc.document_templates] plugin is activated, and the Document Template Type field is selected while configuring the HR service. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: com.sn_hr_core is the core HR plugin but doesn't provide document template functionality.
com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events provides lifecycle event functionality, not document templates.
sn_hr_agent_ws is the Agent Workspace application, not related to document templates.

source.excerpt: Document Template Type - The category for the document template. Note: This option appears only when the Document Templates [com.snc.document_templates] plugin is activated.

questions.question: What is the difference between the 'Opened for' and 'Subject person' fields in an HR case?

options.text: They are always the same and represent the same person
Opened for is the requester, Subject person is who the case is about - they may differ when a manager files a case for an employee
Opened for is the HR agent, Subject person is the employee
Subject person is optional while Opened for is always required

explanation.correct: If the case is being created by the person making the request, the values for Subject person and Opened for are the same. If the case is being created for a different user, for example, a manager filing a case for an employee, use the choice list to select a different user. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: They can be different when someone files a case on behalf of another person.
Opened for is not the HR agent; it represents the person who initiated the case request.
Both fields serve distinct purposes and their requirements depend on the case creation configuration.

source.excerpt: If the case is being created by the person making the request, the values for Subject person and Opened for are the same. If the case is being created for a different user, for example, a manager filing a case for an employee, use the choice list to select a different user.

questions.question: Which role is required to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards?

explanation.correct: The sn_hr_ws.admin role is required to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards. This role allows you to navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.manager provides access to HR cases and profiles but not playbook configuration.
sn_hr_core.case_writer is for creating and managing cases, not playbook configuration.
sn_hr_core.basic provides basic access to HR modules, not admin configuration capabilities.

source.excerpt: Role required: sn_hr_ws.admin. Navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration.

questions.question: Which property determines which playbook card configuration is used when both Classic HR Service Delivery Agent Workspace and Agent Workspace for HR Case Management are installed?

explanation.correct: The property sn_hr_agent_ws.use_uib_playbook_card_config (default value = false) decides which card configuration is used for HR Service Delivery Playbook when you have each Agent Workspace installed. By default, the Classic card configuration will be selected. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This property name doesn't exist in the ServiceNow HR configuration.
This is not a valid ServiceNow HR system property.
This property name is fabricated and doesn't control playbook card configuration.

source.excerpt: The property sn_hr_agent_ws.use_uib_playbook_card_config (default value = false) decides which card configuration is to be used for HR Service Delivery Playbook when you have each Agent Workspace installed.

questions.question: Which third-party background check providers are supported for HR cases in ServiceNow? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: ServiceNow supports requesting background checks through First Advantage, Accurate, or Sterling as third-party background check providers. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Checkr is not listed as a supported background check provider in ServiceNow HR documentation.
HireRight is not listed as a supported integration in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery.

source.excerpt: Request a background check for an employee through a third-party background check provider such as First Advantage, Accurate, or Sterling.

questions.question: When does a DocuSign flow trigger to create signature tasks in an HR case?

options.text: When the case state changes to Ready
When the case is assigned to an agent

explanation.correct: When the case state changes to Ready, the flow triggers and creates DocuSign tasks for all of the signers. For parallel signing, the tasks are assigned all at once. For serial signing, the tasks are created in the order defined. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The DocuSign flow doesn't trigger at case creation; it waits for the Ready state.
Agent assignment doesn't trigger the DocuSign flow.
Signature requests must happen before case closure, not after.

source.excerpt: When the case state changes to Ready, the flow triggers and creates DocuSign tasks for all of the signers. For parallel signing, the tasks are assigned all at once. For serial signing, the tasks are created in the order defined.

questions.question: Which application must be installed to set up Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?

explanation.correct: To set up Agent Workspace for HR Case Management, install the application Agent Workspace for HR Case Management [sn_hr_agent_ws]. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/setup-configurable-hr-agent-workspace.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core is the core HR plugin but is not specifically the Agent Workspace application.
com.sn_hr_service_portal is for Employee Service Center, not Agent Workspace.
sn_hr_le is for Lifecycle Events, not Agent Workspace.

source.excerpt: Install the application Agent Workspace for HR Case Management [sn_hr_agent_ws].

questions.question: Which is NOT a field available in the HR Playbook Card Configuration Type Values section?

explanation.correct: Case Priority is NOT a field in the Type Values section. The Type Values section includes fields like Footer, Icon, Description, Show SLA, Title, Form fields, Tagline, Record fields, Show Checklist, and Assigned to. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Footer is a valid field in Type Values for information appearing at the bottom of a card.
Show SLA is a valid checkbox field to display the SLA icon on the card.
Show Checklist is a valid checkbox field to display the activity checklist on the card.

source.excerpt: The Type Values section determines what appears on each card: Footer, Icon, Description, Show SLA, Title, Form fields, Tagline, Record fields, Show Checklist, Assigned to, Form View.

questions.question: In HR Playbook Card Configuration, what does the 'Order' field determine?

options.text: The display order of cards in the playbook view
The order in which the activity attempts to match this configuration record
The priority of the HR case

explanation.correct: The Order field specifies the order in which the activity attempts to match this record. The lowest values are evaluated first when determining which card configuration applies. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Order field is for configuration matching priority, not visual display order.
Case priority is a separate field on HR cases, not related to playbook card order.
Approval sequences are configured in workflow or flow, not in playbook card configuration.

source.excerpt: Order - The order in which the activity attempts to match this record. The lowest values are evaluated first.

questions.question: Which roles are contained within the HR manager [sn_hr_core.manager] role? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: The HR manager [sn_hr_core.manager] role contains Workspace List Admin [workspace_list_admin] and Workspace user [workspace_user]. The workspace_list_admin is an elevated role, and workspace_user allows access to Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and creates/accesses interactions. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/setup-configurable-hr-agent-workspace.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: chat_admin is contained in the HR Workspace Admin role [sn_hr_agent_ws.admin], not the HR manager role.
awa_agent (Advanced Work Assignment Agent) is contained in the HR agent [sn_hr_core.basic] role, not the manager role.

source.excerpt: HR manager [sn_hr_core.manager] - Contains workspace roles: Workspace List Admin [workspace_list_admin], Workspace user [workspace_user]

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is true about the Work Notes field in an HR case?
a) Text in Work Notes is visible to the Subject person
b) The sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email property controls whether external emails appear in Work Notes
c) Work Notes cannot be translated
d) Work Notes are deleted when a case is closed

options.text: Both a and c are true
Both b and d are true

explanation.correct: Statement b is true: The sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email system property allows a user to send an email from a personal email account referencing an HR case. If this property is set to false (default), the text from the email appears in the Work Notes field. Statement a is false because Work Notes are NOT visible to the Subject person. Statement c is false because Work Notes can be translated using the Translate option. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Statement a is false - Work Notes are explicitly not visible to the Subject person.
Both statements are false - Work Notes are NOT visible to Subject person and CAN be translated.
Statement d is false - Work Notes are retained as part of the case history.

source.excerpt: Work notes - Information specific to the case that can help other HR agents. Text in the Work Notes field is not visible to the user named in the Subject person field. The sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email system property allows a user to send an email from a personal email account referencing an HR case.

questions.question: An HR agent needs to configure all aspects of Agent Workspace for HR Case Management including UI actions, forms, and workspace lists. Which role should be assigned?

explanation.correct: The HR Workspace Admin [sn_hr_agent_ws.admin] role lets you configure all aspects of Agent Workspace for HR Case Management. This role contains workspace_admin, chat_admin, ui_action_admin, form_admin, workspace_list_admin, and many other administrative roles needed for complete workspace configuration. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/setup-configurable-hr-agent-workspace.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.manager grants access to HR cases and profiles but not full workspace configuration.
sn_hr_core.case_writer is for case management, not workspace administration.
sn_hr_core.basic provides basic agent access, not administrative capabilities.

source.excerpt: HR Workspace Admin [sn_hr_agent_ws.admin] - Lets you configure all aspects of Agent Workspace for HR Case Management. Contains: workspace_admin, chat_admin, ui_action_admin, form_admin, workspace_list_admin.

questions.question: Which role allows an HR agent to work customer interactions and manage workload across multiple service channels?

explanation.correct: The Advanced Work Assignment Agent [awa_agent] role allows an HR agent to work customer interactions and manages workload across multiple service channels. This role is contained within the HR agent [sn_hr_core.basic] role. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/setup-configurable-hr-agent-workspace.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: interaction_agent is for performing interaction queue transfers, not workload management across channels.
workspace_user allows access to Agent Workspace but doesn't specifically handle multi-channel workload management.
chat_admin is for administering chat tables, not managing agent workloads.

source.excerpt: HR agent [sn_hr_core.basic] - This role contains the Advanced Work Assignment Agent [awa_agent] role, which allows an HR agent to work customer interactions and manages workload across multiple service channels.

questions.question: What is the navigation path to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards?

options.text: All > HR Case Management > Playbook Cards
All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration

explanation.correct: To configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards, navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: HR Case Management contains case-related modules, not playbook configuration.
Service Portal is for portal widgets, not HR playbook cards.
Workflow is for workflow configuration, not playbook cards.

source.excerpt: Navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration.

questions.question: What determines which electronic signature service (DocuSign vs Adobe Sign) is used for an HR case?

options.text: The HR service configuration associated with the case
The preference set in the employee's HR profile

explanation.correct: The electronic signature service used depends on the HR service configuration. When you request an electronic signature, it can be through either the DocuSign service or the Adobe Acrobat Sign service based on how the HR service is configured. Both integrations follow the same trigger pattern (Ready state) but are configured separately per HR service. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/search-hr-case.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: There is no single system property that determines the default e-sign provider globally.
E-signature service selection is not based on employee profile preferences.
COE assignment rules determine HR agent assignment, not e-signature provider selection.

source.excerpt: Request an electronic signature through the DocuSign service... Request an electronic signature through the Adobe Sign service. When the case state changes to Ready, the flow triggers...

questions.question: An organization wants employees to be able to upload attachments directly from HR playbook cards. Which field in the Playbook Card Configuration should be configured?

explanation.correct: The Attachment source field is used to allow uploading of attachments. Selecting 'associated_record' allows the user to upload an attachment from the card. Note that 'Attachments read only' is for indicating existing attachments can only be read. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/playbook-hr-card-configuration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Attachments read only indicates existing attachments can only be read, not for enabling uploads.
Associated record is listed as 'Not applicable at this time' in the documentation.
Form fields displays editable fields on the card but doesn't control attachment uploads.

source.excerpt: Attachment source - Use to allow uploading of attachments. Selecting associated_record allows the user to upload an attachment from the card.

questions.question: What role is required to configure an HR case template?

explanation.correct: The sn_hr_core.admin role is required to configure an HR case template. This is specified in the 'Before you begin' section of the HR case template configuration documentation.

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.case_writer is a role for creating cases, not configuring templates
sn_hr_ef.document_writer is for employee document management, not template configuration
sn_hr_core.manager has different permissions and is not the required role for template configuration

source.excerpt: Role required: sn_hr_core.admin

questions.question: When configuring an HR case template, what must match between the template and the associated HR service?

explanation.correct: The COE (Center of Excellence) for the HR case template must match that of the associated HR service. The documentation explicitly states: 'Make sure that the COE for the HR case template matches that of the associated HR service.'

wrongAnswers.explanation: Priority is set on the template but does not need to match the HR service
Owning group is specific to the template and does not need to match the service
Assignment type is configured independently on the template

source.excerpt: COE: HR case table (COE) that the HR case is categorized under when a request for that HR service is made. Note: Make sure that the COE for the HR case template matches that of the associated HR service.

questions.question: Which Assignment type options are available when configuring an HR case template? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: When configuring HR case template assignment, you can select either 'Named user' (to assign to a specific user) or 'Skills/Assignment group' (to assign based on skills or a group). These are the two assignment type options documented.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Auto-assignment is not listed as an assignment type option for HR case templates
Round robin is not an assignment type option for HR case templates

source.excerpt: Assignment type: Assignment of the HR case when a request for that HR service is made. You can assign the HR case to a user, skill, or group. Select one of the following: Named user: In the Assigned to field, select a user. Skills/Assignment group: In the Skills or Assignment Group field, select a skill or group.

questions.question: Which system property controls which dynamic variables are excluded from HR task templates to protect privacy?

explanation.correct: The sn_hr_core.task_template_variable_ignore system property is used to exclude dynamic variables that might provide personal information. By default, social security number (ssn) is excluded.

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.template_privacy_exclude is not a valid system property
sn_hr_ef.dynamic_variable_filter is not a valid system property
sn_hr_core.exclude_personal_data is not a valid system property

source.excerpt: Because some dynamic variables might provide personal information, use the sn_hr_core.task_template_variable_ignore system property to ensure privacy. For example, social security number (ssn) is excluded by default.

questions.question: An HR administrator needs to configure an HR case template that requires employees to sign a document when the case is created. Which field should they add to the template?

explanation.correct: To configure cases that require a document acknowledgement or signature, the administrator should add the PDF Template field to the HR case template. This field allows selecting a document for cases requiring signatures.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Signature Required is not a documented field for HR case templates
Document Template option is used to associate document templates from the com.snc.document_templates plugin, not for PDF signatures
E-Sign Document is not a documented field for HR case templates

source.excerpt: For example, you can add the State field to set a default case state or add the PDF Template field to select a document for cases that require a document acknowledgement or signature.

questions.question: What is the navigation path to access HR Service Configuration for managing HR case templates?

options.text: All > HR Case Management > HR Templates
All > HR Administration > HR Services > HR Service Configuration

explanation.correct: The correct navigation path is All > HR Administration > HR Services > HR Service Configuration. From there, you open the HR service and then access the HR template for that service.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This navigation path does not exist in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery
This navigation path does not exist in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery
This navigation path does not exist in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery

source.excerpt: Navigate to All > HR Administration > HR Services > HR Service Configuration. Open the HR service. Open the HR template for that service.
